title: Rig Relay Project Page Compiler Result v1
description: Content-light compiler output for a per-repository project page. Includes the publication projection (conforming to rig.relay.publication_projection.v1, project_page surface), optional static bundle path, preview report, and safety report. Does not represent deployment — that requires separate authority.

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this compiler run

compiler_digest.description: Deterministic SHA256 digest of the compiler output

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when compilation completed

projection.description: ProjectPagePublicationProjection conforming to rig.relay.publication_projection.v1, project_page surface

static_bundle_path.description: Filesystem path to the compiled static preview bundle, or null if no static output was rendered

static_bundle_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the compiled HTML content, or null if no static output

preview_report.description: ProjectPagePreviewReport — what is public, withheld, proposed, and what actions remain

safety_report.description: PublicationSafetyReport — safety scan results for the compiled output

compilation_successful.description: Whether compilation completed without safety or schema failures

deployment_ready.description: Whether the output is ready for GitHub Pages deployment. Always false in preview_only mode.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings from the compilation process
